text:
Situation: Levofloxacin is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 238 tablets of 750 mg (15.7 days) and 315 tablets of 500 mg (18.4 days). Corvale General holds 207 tablets of 750 mg (13.6 days) and 394 tablets of 500 mg (25.2 days). Current inventory provides limited coverage at both sites.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include levofloxacin as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is tight but not classified as a shortage by FDA. The rule-ranked alternate manufacturer is Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list. Camber's supply comes from Hetero Labs Limited Unit V, last inspected VAI on 2022-08-12. Other ranked suppliers (Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC; Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC; Aurobindo Pharma Limited; Chartwell RX, LLC) are not on FDA's shortage list but their labels name no identifiable plant.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to check current purchase orders and allocation limits with Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. — requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to verify Hetero Labs Limited Unit V inspection status remains VAI before committing volume — requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate secondary ranked suppliers if Camber cannot meet allocation needs — requires buyer and P&T committee approval.
4. Pharmacy operations to monitor daily usage at both sites and update days-on-hand weekly — requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: Switching to alternative fluoroquinolones or changing formularies based on current inventory levels; clinical changes are for treating clinicians and the committee.
